texts.zh: 指定[former_crisis.GetName]为“星系危机”的议案如今已被星海参议院废止。作为结果，所有由星海共同体成员国针对[former_crisis.GetSpeciesNamePlural]展开的军事行动都被立马叫停。现在，和平已经降临了星系的这一隅。
texts.en: The resolution designating the [former_crisis.GetName] as a "galactic crisis" has been repealed by the Galactic Senate. As a result, all ongoing military operations being conducted by Community members against the [former_crisis.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are to cease at once. For now, peace has returned to this corner of the galaxy.

texts.zh: 星海参议院已经废止了宣布我们为“星系危机”的议案，所有共同体成员国均接到指令原地待命。针对我们的军事行动停止了……暂时如此。
texts.en: The Galactic Senate has repealed the resolution declaring us a "galactic crisis" and all Community members have been ordered to stand down. Military actions against us have ceased... for now.

texts.zh:
星海参议院已经废止了宣布我们为“星系危机”的议案，所有共同体成员国均接到指令原地待命。针对我们的军事行动停止了……暂时如此。

如果我们还想继续打下去，没什么能够阻止我们对这些蠢蛋分别宣战，然后一个接一个地干翻他们……
texts.en:
The Galactic Senate has repealed the resolution declaring us a "galactic crisis" and all Community members have been ordered to stand down. Military actions against us have ceased... for now.

If we want to continue fighting, there is nothing stopping us from declaring war on the fools individually, taking them out one by one...

label.zh: 理智终于占领了他们大脑的高地了。
label.en: So they came to their senses.
